title: Constitution Day Observed in Manipur; CM Calls for Unity Among 36 Communities
summary: The state-level observance of Constitution Day was held at the Civil Secretariat, Mantripukhri, with Chief Minister Yumnam Khemchand Singh emphasising constitutional values, unity, fraternity and collective responsibility among Manipur's diverse communities.
body:
Constitution Day (Samvidhan Diwas) was observed at the Main Conference Hall of the Civil Secretariat, Mantripukhri, Imphal, with Chief Minister Yumnam Khemchand Singh attending the state-level observance and calling for unity, mutual understanding and collective responsibility among the people of Manipur.

On the occasion, the Chief Minister paid tribute to the founding fathers of the Indian Republic, particularly Dr. B. R. Ambedkar, Chairman of the Drafting Committee of the Constituent Assembly, acknowledging his vision, wisdom and contribution to shaping the Constitution of India.

Emphasising the constitutional ideals enshrined in the Preamble, the Chief Minister urged people to collectively work towards a society based on justice, liberty, equality and fraternity.

He also stressed the importance of unity among Manipur's diverse communities, noting that the state is home to 36 communities. He called upon people to strengthen bonds of love, mutual understanding and unity while upholding the spirit of the Constitution.

As part of the observance, the Chief Minister administered the reading of the Preamble to the Constitution and signed a printed copy.

Deputy Chief Minister Losii Dikho, Home Minister Govindas Konthoujam, Tourism Minister Khuraijam Loken Singh, the Advocate General of Manipur, MLAs, Chief Secretary, senior administrative officers and other government officials attended the programme.

The observance reaffirmed the commitment to constitutional values, democratic principles, Fundamental Rights and Duties, and national unity.

Constitution Day is observed annually on November 26 to commemorate the adoption of the Constitution of India on November 26, 1949.
author: Mirror Lilong Desk
